    h=len(grid); w=len(grid[0])
    border=grid[0][0] if grid[0][0] != grid[0][1] else grid[-1][-1]
    # More robustly, the border color occurs on two complete outer sides.
    from collections import Counter
    border=Counter(grid[0]+grid[-1]+[row[0] for row in grid]+[row[-1] for row in grid]).most_common(1)[0][0]
    bg=grid[h//2][w//2]
    sides={
        'top': all(x==border for x in grid[0]),
        'bottom': all(x==border for x in grid[-1]),

        'right': all(row[-1]==border for row in grid),

    out=[[8]*w for _ in range(h)]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if sides['bottom'] and sides['left']:
                inside=r+c<w-1

    if sides['bottom']:
